game.name: Saints Row IV (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Several years following the events of Saints Row: The Third, the Third Streets Saints leader has been elected as president of the United States. When an alien invasion occurs, the president is sent to a simulation of Steelport, where he/she must use superpowers to fight against the alien invasion.
game.genre: Adventure, Action / Adventure, Action, Adventure / RealTime 3D
